description:
Fetch the full gnomAD population record for one or more variants: allele count, number, and frequency overall and per genetic-ancestry group, homozygote and hemizygote counts, the filtering allele frequency (faf95) — the value to test against a disease threshold such as ACMG/AMP BA1 or BS1, which raw AF is not — quality flags, each callset's own counts and QC filters, the most severe consequence with its HGVS and LOFTEE call beside the same on the gene's MANE Select (else canonical) transcript, gnomAD's manual LoF curations, in-silico scores, and joined ClinVar significance. On gnomad_r4 the overall counts and joint_populations read gnomAD's joint exome + genome data; every other dataset, gnomad_r4_non_ukb and the other subsets included, publishes no joint data, so its overall counts sum the callsets carrying the variant, a QC-failed one included, and joint_populations is empty. qc_status follows gnomAD's browser: pass when at least one callset carrying the variant passed QC, filtered when none did — the browser hides these by default — so treat a filtered variant's counts as low-confidence rather than an observed frequency. Accepts up to 25 IDs with partial success: every declared reason except incoherent_build is reported per item in failed[], with its recovery hint, without failing the other IDs. A coordinate ID carries no build: an absent one whose string also lifts over from the other build fails as variant_not_found_other_build, with the lifted IDs in candidates, while a string valid on both builds can name a different variant on each, which no not-found path can see — so keep IDs on the dataset's build. variant_not_found means the variant is not in the chosen dataset — pair with gnomad_get_coverage to confirm the position is callable before concluding true absence.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

dataset.description: gnomAD dataset, default gnomad_r4: gnomad_r4 and its subset gnomad_r4_non_ukb (GRCh38); gnomad_r3 and its subsets gnomad_r3_controls_and_biobanks, gnomad_r3_non_cancer, gnomad_r3_non_neuro, gnomad_r3_non_topmed, gnomad_r3_non_v2 (GRCh38); gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets gnomad_r2_1_controls, gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer, gnomad_r2_1_non_neuro, gnomad_r2_1_non_topmed (GRCh37); exac (GRCh37). A subset keeps part of its parent release's samples (non_cancer drops cancer-study samples, non_ukb UK Biobank's) and can leave a callset unchanged: gnomad_r4_non_ukb genome counts equal gnomad_r4's, and gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer genome counts equal gnomad_r2_1's.

reference_genome.description: Reference build, derived from dataset when omitted; a build other than the dataset's is rejected. Keep aligned with Ensembl coordinates.

items.description: Variant ID — chrom-pos-ref-alt (1-based, e.g. 1-55051215-G-GA) on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y with an optional chr prefix, or an rsID (rs11591147); mitochondrial IDs (M, MT, chrM) are not served. Obtain one from ensembl_predict_variant or a VCF.

name: gnomad_get_variant

dataset.description: Effective gnomAD dataset used for the batch.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incoherent_build`: reference_genome was supplied but does not match the dataset. `invalid_variant_id`: A variant ID is outside the chrom-pos-ref-alt or rsID grammar. `variant_not_found`: A well-formed ID is absent from the dataset with no liftover candidate: rsIDs are never lifted, and a liftover lookup that fails or runs out of time leaves this reason. `variant_not_found_other_build`: A coordinate ID is absent from the dataset and, read as an ID on the other build, lifts over to the IDs in candidates. `mitochondrial_unsupported`: A variant ID names the mitochondrial chromosome (M, MT, or chrM). `ambiguous_rsid`: An rsID maps to more than one variant in the dataset. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the lookup for one ID with a GraphQL error. `upstream_build_mismatch`: gnomAD answered one ID with a variant on a different reference build. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry for one ID. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out, or the shared 45 s batch budget expired, for one ID. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request for one ID (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering one ID with a response that failed validation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: One failed input ID, why it failed, and what to do next.

candidates.description: Variant IDs to retry with: an ambiguous rsID's chrom-pos-ref-alt IDs, or the IDs a variant_not_found_other_build string lifts over to.

error.description: What went wrong for this ID.

reason.description: Why this ID failed — a reason declared in this tool's error contract. Branch on it rather than on the message.

recovery.description: The next step for this ID — the recovery hint declared for its reason.

variant.description: The input ID that failed to resolve.

found.description: Variants resolved to a population record.

items.description: Full population record for one variant.

af.description: Overall allele frequency, ac/an; null when an is 0.

an.description: Overall allele number. On gnomad_r4, gnomAD's joint AN over every callable sample in both callsets, including a callset that does not carry the variant.

callsets.description: Each callset's own counts and QC filters. A variant can fail QC in one callset and pass in the other. Filter names vary by dataset: on gnomad_r4 AC0 (no high-quality carrier after genotype QC), AS_VQSR, and InbreedingCoeff; RF on gnomad_r2_1.

group.description: Its ancestry group (e.g. nfe); null when gnomAD names none.

faf95.description: This callset's own FAF95; null on the same terms as the record's faf95.

filters.description: QC filters on this call; empty when it passed, null when gnomAD returned no list.

exome.description: Null when this callset does not carry the variant.

group.description: Its ancestry group (e.g. nfe); null when gnomAD names none.

faf95.description: This callset's own FAF95; null on the same terms as the record's faf95.

filters.description: QC filters on this call; empty when it passed, null when gnomAD returned no list.

genome.description: Null when this callset does not carry the variant.

anyOf.description: ClinVar significance as gnomAD joins it.

clinical_significance.description: ClinVar clinical significance (e.g. Pathogenic, Likely benign).

clinvar.description: Null when the variant has no ClinVar entry.

clinvar_unavailable.description: True when the ClinVar lookup failed or ran out of time, so clinvar is null for want of an answer.

consequence.description: The most severe VEP consequence term across the variant's transcripts, as gnomAD reports it; null when none.

group.description: Its ancestry group (e.g. nfe); null when gnomAD names none.

source.description: Where the value comes from: gnomAD's joint data, or that callset.

faf95.description: gnomAD's filtering allele frequency (GroupMax FAF95): the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of a genetic-ancestry group's AF, from the group with the highest bound, over non-bottlenecked groups only. From the joint data on gnomad_r4, even when that value is null; elsewhere the higher of the callsets' faf95, which source names. Null for AC 0 and singleton variants, on exac, and on a gnomad_r4 or gnomad_r3 subset, whose record carries the parent release's FAF (a notice names the parent; gnomad_list_gene_variants' faf95_max is gnomad_r4_non_ukb's own).

gene_symbol.description: Gene symbol for the reported consequence; null when none.

hemizygote_count.description: Overall hemizygote count (0 off X/Y); null when gnomAD reports none.

hgvsc.description: HGVS coding or transcript notation (e.g. c.406G>T); null when none.

hgvsp.description: HGVS protein notation (e.g. p.Glu136Ter); null when gnomAD gives none, as for a UTR or intronic change.

in_silico.description: In-silico predictor scores present for this variant.

annotation.description: Text gnomAD attaches to the score — on gnomad_r3, the SpliceAI event (e.g. acceptor_gain) — or the raw text when value is null for lack of a number; null for a plain score.

id.description: Predictor name. Ids vary by dataset — gnomad_r4: cadd, revel_max, spliceai_ds_max, pangolin_largest_ds, phylop, sift_max, polyphen_max; gnomad_r3: cadd, revel, splice_ai, primate_ai; gnomad_r2_1 and exac carry none.

value.description: Predictor score; null when not provided, or when gnomAD gave text with no number (then in annotation).

joint_populations.description: Per-ancestry counts in gnomAD's joint data, over the same samples as an.

items.description: One genetic-ancestry group's counts in gnomAD's joint exome + genome data.

lof.description: LOFTEE's loss-of-function call — HC high-confidence, LC low-confidence, or OS other splice; null when it made none.

lof_curations.description: gnomAD's manual loss-of-function curations of this variant, which can overturn a LOFTEE call; empty when gnomAD has none.

items.description: One of gnomAD's manual loss-of-function curations of the variant.

flags.description: The reasons the curators recorded, as gnomAD writes them (e.g. Weak Exon Conservation); empty when none.

gene_id.description: Ensembl gene ID the curation is for.

gene_symbol.description: Its gene symbol; null when gnomAD gives none.

project.description: The curation project the verdict comes from (e.g. metabolic_conditions_genes).

verdict.description: The curators’ verdict (e.g. LoF, Likely LoF, Not LoF).

lof_filter.description: The LOFTEE filter that made that call low-confidence (e.g. END_TRUNC); null when none.

lof_flags.description: LOFTEE's flags on that call, as gnomAD writes them (e.g. PHYLOCSF_WEAK); null when none.

populations.description: Per-ancestry counts of each carrying callset — never collapsed to a single global AF.

items.description: One genetic-ancestry group's counts in one callset.

id.description: Genetic-ancestry group: afr, amr, asj, eas, fin, mid, nfe, sas, ami (genomes only), and the catch-all group — remaining on gnomad_r4 and gnomad_r4_non_ukb, oth on every other dataset.

source.description: The callset this vector comes from.

anyOf.description: The variant's consequence on its gene's primary transcript.

consequence.description: Most severe VEP consequence term on this transcript; null when none.

hgvsc.description: HGVSc on this transcript; null when none.

hgvsp.description: HGVSp on this transcript; null when none.

is_mane_select.description: True for the gene's MANE Select transcript. For a canonical entry, false, or null where gnomAD reports no MANE status: a gene without a MANE Select (such as a lncRNA), and every gene on a GRCh37 dataset.

lof.description: LOFTEE's call on this transcript; null when none.

lof_filter.description: LOFTEE filter on that call; null when none.

lof_flags.description: LOFTEE flags on that call; null when none.

primary_transcript.description: The consequence on the gene's primary transcript: its MANE Select entry, else its canonical entry. Null when the variant has no transcript consequence or lies outside both transcripts (e.g. on CDKN2A's p14ARF exon 1β, which only minor isoforms carry).

qc_status.description: gnomAD's QC verdict for the variant.

reference_genome.description: Reference build the record is on.

source.description: Which gnomAD callset(s) carry this variant.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID (unversioned) the consequence is on, which hgvsc, hgvsp, lof, lof_filter, and lof_flags also describe; not necessarily the gene's MANE Select or canonical transcript — it can be a minor isoform, so read it beside primary_transcript. Null when none.

notice.description: Set when ClinVar annotation was unavailable for a record, and on a subset whose records' faf95 is null, naming the parent release to read it from.

reference_genome.description: Effective reference build used for the batch.
